info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Model Management API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Model Management API enables users to create and manage trading models used in wholesale banking operations. With this API, financial institutions can efficiently develop tailored trading strategies that align with their business goals. This service is primarily designed for traders and banking professionals who require automated model creation and updates. The API allows for seamless integration of trading models into existing workflows, enhancing decision-making in dynamic market environments.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new trading model within the wholesale trading system. It accepts a request body containing the necessary details for the trading model and returns a confirmation upon successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary components to create a new trading model in the wholesale trading system. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the JSON format as defined in the schema.

quantity.description: Quantity of the instrument to be traded.

limitPrice.description: The maximum price at which a trade will be executed.
